region: Union Springs · Cayuga Lake, Finger Lakes, New York
about: Heart & Hands is the Cayuga Lake winery of Tom and Susan Higgins, who went looking for limestone before they went looking for land. Tom, a Finger Lakes native, left a technology career for wine, working at Zachy’s, at Château La Lagune in Bordeaux and in local cellars. In 2007 the couple bought a gentle slope above Carr’s Cove on the lake’s eastern shore, just north of Union Springs, and planted their first vines in 2010. Today they make about 2,000 cases a year of cool-climate wines.

Aligoté is Burgundy’s “other” white grape, long grown beside Chardonnay on the Côte d’Or and valued for its brisk acidity. Heart & Hands planted it in 2019 on its estate, over the Onondaga limestone the winery likens to the stone beneath Burgundy’s villages. The vineyard is certified sustainable and farmed without herbicides or insecticides. At harvest the grapes are hand-picked and basket-pressed, then fermented in separate lots by block, clone and vessel, in stainless steel and in larger neutral French oak barrels.

The 2022 growing season was warm and very dry, giving small berries and very low yields, and the winery lists Aligoté among the grapes it harvested and made into wine for the first time that year. Its tasting note points to lemon zest and fresh herbs on the nose, then white peach, green apple, a flinty, mineral line and a touch of salinity.
